Question: gad diagnosis code

Answer: The International Classification of Diseases (ICD-10) diagnosis code for Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD) is F41.1.

0.fact: The International Classification of Diseases (ICD-10) diagnosis code for Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD) is F41.1.
0.explanation: The ICD-10-CM code F41.1 is the official and most commonly used diagnosis code for Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD) according to multiple authoritative sources including WHO and US healthcare coding standards. This code is used for billing and clinical documentation purposes and became effective in the 2024 edition of ICD-10-CM.
